requirements.quote: Quality Conformance Inspections shall comply with the following:
requirements.text: Quality conformance inspections must meet specified requirements.

requirements.quote: The witnessing of the pre-shipment operational test by the PURCHASER does not relieve the VENDOR of any responsibility regarding the quality of the component provided.
requirements.text: Vendor retains responsibility for component quality despite purchaser witnessing tests.

requirements.quote: The PURCHASER or authorized representative shall have access to the VENDOR’s shop procedures, schedules, testing, and inspection procedures and documents.
requirements.text: Purchaser must have access to vendor's shop procedures and documents.

requirements.quote: The VENDOR shall verify by test that the complete electrical system with its components complies with all its performance requirements.
requirements.text: Vendor must test the electrical system to ensure compliance with performance requirements.

requirements.quote: Except where more stringent industry standards are to be performed, all VENDOR’s normal quality control tests shall be performed.
requirements.text: Vendor must perform all normal quality control tests unless stricter standards apply.

requirements.quote: Use VENDOR’s standard design whenever consistent with the intent of these Specifications.
requirements.text: Vendor should use standard design if it aligns with specifications.

requirements.quote: Use only new, unused equipment and materials.
requirements.text: Vendor must use new and unused equipment and materials.

requirements.quote: The VENDOR shall assume full responsibility for wiring accuracy, electrical operation, sequence and wiring tests shall be conducted in strict accordance with approved design documents.
requirements.text: Vendor is responsible for wiring accuracy and must test according to approved designs.

requirements.quote: The VENDOR shall perform all necessary operational tests to assure proper operation of the component and performance in accordance with the requirements of this Specification.
requirements.text: Vendor must perform operational tests to ensure component compliance.

requirements.quote: Factory tests shall be made with the breaker assembled, as it will be used in the field.
requirements.text: Factory tests must be conducted with the breaker fully assembled.

requirements.quote: The VENDOR shall provide certified test reports for all tests performed.
requirements.text: Vendor must provide certified reports for all tests.

requirements.quote: The VENDOR shall provide test certificates that the design and rating of Metal Clad Switchgear for Type and Routine tests carried out.
requirements.text: Vendor must provide test certificates for switchgear design and rating.

requirements.quote: The PURCHASER reserves the right to inspect Metal Clad Switchgear and witness all tests at the VENDORs works prior to the shipment to prove compliance with the Specification.
requirements.text: Purchaser may inspect and witness tests at vendor's facility before shipment.

requirements.quote: The VENDOR shall notify the PURCHASER 10 working days in advance of the commencement of the tests.
requirements.text: Vendor must notify purchaser 10 days before tests begin.
